# Dimitrios Xynos

> Dimitrios Xynos is a full-stack developer based in Greece. This portfolio presents his experience, skills, services, and selected projects.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://dxynos.com/): Introduction, experience, skills, and contact information.
- [Selected projects](https://dxynos.com/#projects): Project previews and details about Fresh Cuts Booking and Kivia.
- [Digital business card](https://dxynos.com/card): Contact details and professional links.

## Selected projects

- [Fresh Cuts Booking](https://booking.freshcuts.gr/): Appointment booking platform for a barbershop.
- [Fresh Cuts Barber Studio](https://freshcuts.gr/): Barbershop website.
- [Panos Koufoudakis Dietitian](https://koufoudakis-dietitian.gr/): Dietitian's website.
- [Kivia](https://usekivia.com/): Nutrition practice management platform.
